summary.pt: Mais de 3 anos de experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções com Google Cloud e [[Google Workspace]]. Automação de processos com [[Apps Script]], desenvolvimento de aplicativos com AppSheet, dashboards com Looker Studio + BigQuery e serviços em Cloud Run. No front-end: [[React]], Next.js, TypeScript e Tailwind CSS. Fluxos de desenvolvimento assistidos por IA generativa aplicados em projetos profissionais.
summary.en: Software Developer with over 3 years of professional experience building web applications, specializing in [[front-end development]] with [[React]], Next.js, TypeScript and JavaScript. Experienced in responsive interfaces, reusable components, [[REST API integrations]] and enterprise systems. Contributed to projects for five large corporate clients and an industrial ERP focused on process digitization and factory productivity. Additional experience with Google Cloud Platform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, SQL, BigQuery and Firebase in remote teams and agile environments.
